svg.title: EDA Pilot AI architecture
svg.desc: Benchmark harness, LangGraph agent, MCP server, guardrails, WSL execution of OpenROAD Flow Scripts, and run artifacts.

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The model (or the offline advisor) only diagnoses and proposes. Validation, launch and metrics are code. Nothing reaches make unvalidated.
compare_results.py → leaderboard by smallest passing clock (DRC = 0, setup WNS ≥ 0, hold WNS ≥ 0) → results/*.json · reports/*.md · plots/*.png

svg.text: next iteration until the run budget is spent or the passing clock gap < 0.05 ns
Advisor: offline clock search (used in the benchmark)
or a chat model via EDA_PILOT_MODEL (analyse + propose only)
A model cannot launch a flow, invent a metric, or skip a range check.
